purpose: One record for each superseded single-use receipt and dead delivery artifact removed from evidence/ and deliverables/. Nothing in the repository read any of them. Tracked entries are recoverable at their byte identity from Git history at the commit named below.
retained_receipts_note: Receipts still cited by code, documents, tools or the delivery configuration stay as files under evidence/.

superseded_deliverables.note: Dead intermediate and superseded delivery artifacts. The protected *_Revised_20261014 pair stays as history; deliverables/current_delivery.json selects the *_v1_1_20261015 pair published after the member-allocation table was added. All are recoverable from Git history at the commits noted here.

superseded_local_outputs.note: Git-ignored groupmate packs that were never committed, so these are NOT recoverable from history. Regenerate with tools/package_groupmate_handover.py, which selects the current reviewed PDFs. The current pack Investify_Mid1_Groupmates_v1_1_20261014_release.zip is retained.
